In PostgreSQL, policies are combined with OR across policies for each command. So for SELECT, there are two policies: "Users can read own account" (using auth.uid() = user_id) and "No changes to accounts" (using false). The OR of true (if matches) and false yields true for owners. So select works. For INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, only the "No changes" policy applies (since the read policy only for select). Using false denies. So good.
